facts.text: My whole body has been swelling up.
My belly has swollen up much more than the rest of me.

facts.item: how long the swelling, poor appetite and weight loss have lasted
facts.text: The swelling, the poor appetite and the weight loss have been going on for four months.
My skin and eyes haven't turned yellow.
As far as I know I haven't been exposed to TB.
I was healthy before this; I don't have any medical problems.

gold.reasoning: 1. Cryptogenic chronic liver disease — “the findings were in favour of possible decompensated chronic liver disease” … “the CLD workup did not reveal any potential aetiology.” 2. Constrictive pericarditis — “transthoracic echocardiography showed … no evidence of constrictive pericarditis.” 3. Congestive heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, and renal impairment — “Other causes of generalised oedema … were also excluded by history, physical examination, and basic investigations.” 4. Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis — “There was no evidence of spontaneous bacterial peritonitis.” 5. Malignancy — “ascitic fluid cytology was negative for malignant cells.”

x016: The source reports ultrasound and CT together; both return the shared result. Its closing clause ('raising concern for decompensated chronic liver disease') is the clinicians' interpretation and is dropped.
x018: The individual tests of the cirrhosis workup are not given; any request for them returns 'Unrevealing'.
x020: 'Elevated inflammatory markers' in the ascitic fluid are not specified (e.g. no protein, albumin gradient, cell count or adenosine deaminase values).

source_issues: The ascitic fluid analysis gives no cell count, protein, serum-ascites albumin gradient or adenosine deaminase; only 'exudative ... with elevated inflammatory markers'.
No peritoneal biopsy or laparoscopy result is reported; the diagnosis rests on exudative ascites, negative alternatives and a 17 mm tuberculin reaction.
notes: Index visit: the outpatient presentation with four months of generalized swelling, disproportionate ascites, poor appetite and weight loss (s001-s012); the later staged tests are findings of the same workup.
s010 (diuretics started) is treatment and is excluded.
'Previously healthy' (s001) gives the blanket 'chronic medical problems' denial; s003 adds specific denials of heart, kidney and liver disease and alcohol.
